text: The agent recommends coding this Dell Technologies invoice to 1540 Computer Hardware (cost centre CC4410) with 94.4% confidence, overriding the vendor default of 6420 Repairs & Maintenance. 55 past invoices for these items were coded to 1540, while 6420 has been used only for the ProSupport hardware service contract (5 invoices), and 3 past lines keyed to the default were reclassified at close an average of 40 days later. The invoice was not raised against a required PO and has been logged to the procurement non-compliance report. It is also routed to Fixed Asset Accounting (10 units × $1,845.00; $20,009.03 incl. tax), which keeps the capitalisation decision.
